# /words/ — arif-fazil.com Words · Doctrine · Essays · Law

## What this is
The **Words** lane of the arifOS federation: the sovereign reading room.
Houses the constitutional essays, doctrine, law (F1–F13 floors), the
canonical governance files, and the MakcikGPT civic-journalism corpus.
This is where the person behind the federation thinks in public.

## Key pages
- Writing index: https://arif-fazil.com/words/writing/
- Essays (direct publications): https://arif-fazil.com/words/writing/<slug>/
- MakcikGPT (Bahasa Malaysia civic journalism): https://arif-fazil.com/world/makcikgpt/
- Genesis / sovereign anchor: https://arif-fazil.com/000/
- Canon (governance files): https://arif-fazil.com/canon/

## Essays — machine-readable path
- `/words/writing/` index lists 15+ direct publications (S4 Governance Canon,
  S6 EUREKA Trilogy, S8 The Forge).
- Each essay has a static shell + markdown mirror for text-only crawlers:
  `https://arif-fazil.com/words/writing/<slug>/index.md`
- llms.txt for the writing sub-surface: https://arif-fazil.com/words/writing/llms.txt

## Register / voice
- English essays: intellectual, direct register. **"stupid" is correct English;
  "BANGANG" belongs only to the Makcik register.**
- MakcikGPT: village-auntie voice, Bahasa Malaysia, kampung analogies.
  Persona travels; the author's name does not appear in the articles.
- Content is the sovereign's words, verbatim. No invented quotes, no
  fabricated citations.

## Constitutional floors
The Words lane is governed by F1–F13 (see https://arif-fazil.com/000/ and
the canonical floor table in the arifOS kernel docs).
